product.name: PlayForge TowerBuilder 300
product.description: The PlayForge TowerBuilder 300 is a versatile set of 300 interlocking plastic blocks designed to spark creativity in children and hobbyists alike. Each block is crafted from durable, BPA‑free PET, ensuring safety and longevity. The blocks come in a rainbow palette of bright colors, encouraging imaginative play and basic engineering concepts. With a maximum stack height of 30 cm, the set offers a satisfying challenge for ages 3 and up while fitting comfortably into a standard storage box. The lightweight design makes it easy to transport, and the clear packaging includes quick‑start diagrams for building classic towers, bridges, and simple machines. Ideal for classroom activities, family game nights, or solo construction projects, this set promotes fine motor skills and spatial reasoning.
